definitions.explanation: Used to correct or reconsider what was said.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{否|いや}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{否|いや}、⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧て。
{否|いや}、⟦{考|かんが}え{直|なお}そう→考え直す：04591_kangaenaosu⟧。
{否|いや}、⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{四人|よにん}→四人：30566_yonin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: No, rather it was four people, not three.

examples.japanese: {否|いや}、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧。
{否|いや}、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{否|いや}、⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Actually, let's go today after all. It might rain tomorrow.

notes:
{否|いや} is used in two main ways: as a negative response meaning "no" and as a self-correction marker meaning "no, wait" or "rather."

SENSE 1 — NEGATION:
As a negative response, it is more formal and literary than ⟦いいえ→いいえ：02845_iie⟧. Often found in written language, speeches, and formal discussions.
- ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧: for and against
- {否|いや}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧: cannot say no
- ⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧: denial, negation

SENSE 2 — SELF-CORRECTION:
Used at the start of a sentence to retract or revise what was just said. Common in natural speech.
- {否|いや}、⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧…: no, actually…
- {否|いや}、⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: no wait

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いいえ→いいえ：02845_iie⟧: no (standard polite)
- ⟦ううん→ううん：20371_uun⟧: no (casual)
- {否|いや}: no (formal) / actually (self-correction)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧ (unpleasant, disagreeable) — same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.
